Group homomorphisms, normal subgroups, quotient groups, Lagrange's theorem, ring ideals, unique factorization domains (UFD), and field extensions. Prerequisites: Completion of introductory undergraduate coursework in relevant engineering or scientific disciplines.

Industrial Microbiology and Downstream Processing. Production of pharmaceuticals and industrial metabolites using microbes. Secondary metabolite biosynthesis, cell disruption techniques, centrifugation, ultrafiltration, and preparative chromatography. Prerequisites: Upper-division undergraduate standing and permission of the instructor.

Bioprocess Engineering and Microbial Fermentation. Engineering principles of microbial cell cultivation. Stoichiometry of cell growth, batch and fed-batch fermentation kinetics, oxygen mass transfer rate (kLa), bioreactor scale-up, and continuous bioprocessing. Recommended background: Prior exposure to core analytical concepts and methodological reasoning.

course_title: Hydraulic Engineering and Open Channel Flow
description: Hydraulic Engineering and Open Channel Flow. Fluid flow in open channels and pipe networks. Manning's uniform flow equation, specific energy, hydraulic jumps, gradually varied flow profile computations, and culvert hydraulic sizing. Targeted towards undergraduate and beginning graduate students in relevant university programs.

Mechanical Vibrations and Modal Analysis. Vibration analysis of single and multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical systems. Harmonic excitation, resonance response, vibration isolation dampers, continuous beam vibration, and modal extraction. Prerequisites: Completion of introductory undergraduate coursework in relevant engineering or scientific disciplines.

Kinematics and Dynamics of Mechanisms. Planar mechanism motion analysis. Four-bar linkages, velocity and acceleration polygon methods, dynamic force balancing, flywheel inertia determination, and balancing of rotating machinery. Recommended background: Prior exposure to core analytical concepts and methodological reasoning.

Relational Database Management Systems. Database management internals, relational data algebra, declarative SQL optimization, B+ tree indexing structures, query execution plans, ACID transaction concurrency, and write-ahead logging protocols. Targeted towards undergraduate and beginning graduate students in relevant university programs.

Point-Set and Algebraic Topology. Topological spaces and continuous mappings. Homeomorphisms, separation axioms, product topologies, connectedness, compactness, fundamental groups, and covering space theory. Prerequisites: Completion of introductory undergraduate coursework in relevant engineering or scientific disciplines.

course_title: Ordinary Differential Equations and Dynamical Systems

Existence and uniqueness theorems (Picard-Lindelof), phase portrait analysis, Lyapunov stability theory, and bifurcation behavior. Polymer Reaction Engineering and Processing. Polymerization kinetics and processing techniques. Electrodynamics and Classical Field Theory. Maxwell's equations and relativistic electromagnetic fields. Biochemical Reaction and Bioseparation Engineering. Engineering analysis of biological reaction systems. Statistical Mechanics and Thermal Physics. Microscopic foundations of macroscopic thermodynamic behavior. Investment Analysis and Portfolio Management. Modern portfolio theory and capital asset pricing model (CAPM). Classical Applied Thermodynamics. Fundamental thermodynamic principles for engineering systems. Distributed Cloud Systems Architecture. Architectural principles of fault-tolerant distributed systems.
